# Variables:
#   $count - the number items
filter-count-items = {
    $count ->
        [one] { $count } item
        *[other] { $count } items
    }

# Variables:
#   $visible - the number of visible items
#   $total - the total number of items
filter-count-visible-of-total = { $visible } of { $total }
